_note: Polyomino footprints per hand (writing-system-rune-spec §2-3). The glyph never changes; the INSTRUMENT sets the minimum size at which the mark stays legible — charcoal can't render fine detail, so the same rune must be drawn large. Crude shapes are irregular on purpose: the scrawl is awkward to fit. Cells are [column, row] offsets from the shape's origin. A rune's shape is picked from its hand's list deterministically by rune id, so the same rune always draws the same way without authoring 149 x 3 shapes by hand. All PLACEHOLDER.
